engineering_objective: Complete the inherited catalog OLTP plane so snapshot isolation, commit-time constraints, secondary indexes, WAL-decoded logical CDC, LSN/epoch-fenced replica apply, and checkpoint redo stay consistent.
native_artifact: /app/catalog heap/WAL/indexes plus replica.sqlite and out/health.json apply-report.json cdc.jsonl

root_cause_clusters.RC_VIS: Visible row selection ignores xmin/xmax snapshot rules and leaks uncommitted versions.
root_cause_clusters.RC_CDC: CDC is dual-written from the latest heap row instead of decoding committed WAL.
root_cause_clusters.RC_CON: Constraints run against replica state or all versions, and skip frozen-tenant / hold-qty rules.
root_cause_clusters.RC_IDX: Secondary indexes update before commit and index invisible versions.
root_cause_clusters.RC_APPLY: Replica apply ignores LSN monotonicity, epoch fencing, and FK apply order.
root_cause_clusters.RC_RECOVER: Redo installs uncommitted WAL and skips the checkpoint LSN.
root_cause_clusters.RC_CLI: The CLI mutates WAL/heap before argv is valid, and --reset-output truncates WAL.
